one_liner: Freddie Freeman kept squaring the ball up in 2025: a .346 estimated wOBA on contact over 835 batted balls.
three_things: High contact volume -- 835 batted balls, among the most in this group.
A line-drive profile more than raw thump: 84.3 mph average exit velocity, 102.3 mph at the 90th percentile.
Four-seam fastballs were 31.5% of the 2,372 pitches he saw; 49.0% landed in the rulebook zone.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (>=300 pitches-faced floor). Contact numbers are over the 835 batted balls only, not all 2,372 pitches, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model that ignores walks and strikeouts. No swing/miss or launch-angle column in this pull, so no whiff rate or barrel profile. Not park- or opponent-adjusted; not a prediction. 'Among the most' is scoped to these twelve hitters.
